title: 💔 Over 1,300 people on Maui are still missing. As we go into day 8 of...
description: 💔 Over 1,300 people on Maui are still missing. As we go into day 8 of this horrible tragedy, it’s become increasingly clear that most of these people did not make it through the fire.  ☹️ This will likely be the worst fire since in our country since 1870 and it should not have happened in 2023. There were no emergency phone alerts (to anyone one the island, not just in Lahaina where communication systems were down). They did not activate the coastal alarm system. Nobody knew there was a fire until it was at their doorstep. 🔥 They say that the fire was hot enough to burn steel. However, when firefighters reached Lahaina to fight the fire, they found that several of the hydrants had no water at all. Civilians could not escape by car, because there were downed powerlines covering the streets of Lahaina (which people had begged the county to replace for years due to safety hazards & Maui’s notoriously high winds).  💦 People will speak of climate change and while that is absolutely a factor, let us not overlook the fact that Western industry destroyed the natural ecosystem of the island. They chopped down the coastline’s natural forests in favor of towns, developed areas that used to be marshlands, and on many areas of the island planted thousands of acres of sugar cane which depleted the soil of its nutrients (not to mention they would burn these fields to clear them after harvest).  🏝️ All these things led to a significantly drier atmosphere on the South & West side, paving the way for fires to ravage these lands. Those conditions, combined with hurricane level winds & a poor county infastructure are part of the reason we are dealing this tragedy today. 💎 Please consider donating to some of the great organizations helping our community like Hawai’i Community Foundation or Maui United Way. So many people need support right now. #lahaina #lahainafire #maui #mauifire #mauifires @Sky | Underwater Photographer @Finfolk Productions
